title: Bledsoe's craft bigger inside than outside
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Bledsoe's craft bigger inside than outside, about undated at North Carolina, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Chris Bless tells the story 30t on the outside and he looks inside and it's the size of a football game.

plain: A UFO researcher, Grant Cameron, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an experience of Chris Bledsoe, a man in North Carolina who says he has had UFO encounters. Cameron says that Bledsoe describes a craft about 30 feet across on the outside, but when he looked inside, it seemed the size of a football field. If true, the craft would be bending space in a way nothing we build can.
